blocks.text: To edit a client forwarding policy rule:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Private Access > Steering > Client Forwarding Policy.
Locate the client forwarding policy rule you want to modify and click the Edit icon.

blocks.text: If you only want to change a client forwarding policy rule's place in the Rule Order, you can manually enter in a new value on the Client Forwarding Policy page.

blocks.item: In the Edit Rule window, modify fields as necessary. For more information about each field, see Configuring Client Forwarding Policies.
